title: Supports and densities of a current whose measure is H^d⌞L ⊗ μ₀
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, L ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace with d := dim L < n, S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) and S₀ ∈ 𝒟_{n−d}(ℝ^P) with integer multiplicity representations R (IMRep univ n) of S and R₀ (IMRep univ (n − d)) of S₀; μ := R.measure, μ₀ := R₀.measure. Assume μ₀(ℝ^P ∖ L^⊥) = 0, μ(A) = ∫_L μ₀(A − t) dH^d(t) for every Borel A (written ∫⁻ t in L, μ₀((fun y => t + y)⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[d]), and that S₀ has a density at every point of L^⊥ (for y ∈ L^⊥ there is θ with HasMassDensity S₀ y θ). Then for all t ∈ L and y ∈ L^⊥: t + y ∈ spt S ⟺ y ∈ spt S₀, and, for every θ ∈ ℝ, HasMassDensity S (t + y) θ ⟺ HasMassDensity S₀ y θ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (S₀ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L)) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R₀ : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n - Module.finrank ℝ L)), Module.finrank ℝ L < n → R.Represents S → R₀.Represents S₀ → R₀.measure (Lᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure A = ∫⁻ t in (L : Set (Euclid P)), R₀.measure ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[Module.finrank ℝ L]) → (∀ y ∈ Lᗮ, ∃ θ : ℝ, HasMassDensity S₀ y θ) → (∀ t ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ Lᗮ, (t + y ∈ S.support ↔ y ∈ S₀.support)) ∧ ∀ t ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ Lᗮ, ∀ θ : ℝ, (HasMassDensity S (t + y) θ ↔ HasMassDensity S₀ y θ)
